transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been feeling worn out all the time. Even if I spend a full night in bed, it feels like my body is made of sandbags. Getting through a workday—or even doing something like folding laundry—takes everything I have.
Aside from feeling exhausted, have you been feeling persistently down or depressed?

Yeah. Most days I wake up with this heavy, flat feeling in my chest. I’ll just sit at the kitchen table staring out at the yard and think... there doesn’t seem to be any good version of the future coming.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
It’s been most days for about two months now—the exhaustion and feeling slowed down.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling this depressed and exhausted before in your life?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of a specific time that was exactly like this.
Did a specific stressful event or major life change occur around the time these feelings began?
I think it started around when we took on the mortgage, about two months ago. I’d been really overcharged, pushing hard with the business stuff, and then my mood just dropped into this low stretch.
During that time when you felt overcharged, did you find yourself needing much less sleep than usual to feel rested?
I’m not sure. I don’t remember really noticing a change in how much sleep I needed.
During that time when you felt overcharged, did you experience your thoughts racing or jumping quickly from one idea to another?

Yeah, I think so. I’d be trying to do one thing, then an email ping or a renovation update would pull me off, or I’d get some random idea and switch to that. I kept bouncing between things and leaving them half-finished.
About how long did that period of feeling overcharged last?
It was around the time we took on the mortgage, so about two months ago. I was in that overcharged business push, and then it shifted into this low stretch.
During that time, about how many days or weeks in a row did that overcharged feeling last before your mood dropped?
It started around when we took on the mortgage, about two months ago. I had that overcharged push for a while, and then it turned into this low stretch.
During that overcharged time, did you feel an unusually high level of self-confidence, or feel like you had special abilities or talents beyond what is typical for you?

Yeah. For a while I was really convinced I could quickly outgrow my firm and build my own consulting business better than anyone around me. I hadn’t actually lined up clients or anything, but at the time it felt like I could just make it happen.
